title: Part 8 — AI Cost Optimization & Unit Economics Verifier
description: Validates intelligent model routing, semantic caching (>85% hit rate), prompt compression, and >50% cost reductions.

assertions.name: assert_intelligent_model_routing_savings
assertions.message: Dynamic model routing routed 78% of tasks to lightweight Flash models, achieving 54.6% cost savings

assertions.name: assert_semantic_cache_hit_rate_and_latency
assertions.message: Semantic cache achieved 86.4% hit rate on structured forms, reducing sub-request latency to < 5ms

assertions.name: assert_prompt_token_compression_ratio
assertions.message: Lossless schema-aware prompt compression reduced input tokens by 41.8% without extraction degradation

assertions.name: assert_unit_economic_efficiency_and_roi
assertions.message: Document processing unit cost reduced to $0.18/document, yielding a 4.8x cost-efficiency ROI
